description: This file defines the FontResolverInfo class in the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, which encapsulates information about a specific font face used for rendering in PDF documents. It includes properties for font face name, style simulations (bold/italic), collection number, and internal key management. The class provides multiple constructors for initialization and serves as a means to resolve font data within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: FontResolverInfo
classes.description: Represents the physical font to be used for rendering a particular XFont, including style simulations and unique identification.
